read_method: agent page-fetch tool (markdown rendering of the live official page); each value below was copied by hand from that rendering, never from a community file
egress_note: The build sandbox has no outbound access to nfl.com (GitHub, npm and PyPI only), so a live read from inside a plain shell command is impossible. These reads were taken through the agent's fetch tool, which is why they carry a read window instead of a capture hash. The scripted capture path in scripts/capture_results.py records raw bytes and SHA-256 when it runs in GitHub Actions, which does have egress.

club_record_chips_read.note: Each value is the win-loss-tie chip the official page printed beside the club on 2026-11-16. The ledger's computed record through Week 10 is compared with it by scripts/build_ledger.py; a chip is never used to fill a score and a score is never used to fill a chip.

unread.reason: The club's record chip appears on the Week 11 Monday-night fixture row and in the tail of the Week 10 schedule page, neither of which was inside the chunks read on 2026-11-16. The cell is left blank rather than filled from the arithmetic, because a self-computed record is not an official reading and the cross-check would then compare the ledger with itself.
